name: act_and_mul
description: Fused gated activation with signature act_and_mul(gateup_output, activation='silu', swiglu_limit=None). For a 2-D input of shape [m, 2*d], split the last dimension into gate = gateup_output[:, :d] and up = gateup_output[:, d:], convert both halves to float32, optionally clamp gate to <= swiglu_limit and up to [-swiglu_limit, swiglu_limit], apply SiLU or tanh-approximated GELU to gate, cast both the activated gate and up back to the input dtype, multiply, and cast the product to the input dtype. Return a newly allocated [m, d] tensor without mutating or aliasing the input. The correctness and benchmark suites exercise bfloat16 inputs with SiLU/GELU and with or without swiglu_limit.
